name: sched-walt
scope: Pinned Motorola/Qualcomm sched_walt (canoe: WALT=m, MIDPOINT, MOTO_UNFAIR; DEBUG/STATS off) ported to android18-7.3
reviewed_changes: 7.3 API: register_syscore + data callbacks, __task_rq_unlock(rq,p,rf), dev_offline_disabled(), CONFIG_SYSCTL, stop_one_cpu_nowait() void, WQ_PERCPU explicit
h_nr_running -> h_nr_queued (6.12 h_nr_running was a KABI alias of h_nr_queued)
binder need_reply -> !is_async && !is_reply (identical facts); saved boost in restored binder_transaction vendor data
CPU halt uses restored android_pick_task(rq, rf) and __balance_callbacks(rq, NULL)
MVP mutex ordering ported to the 7.3 waiter ring: hook only chooses the waiter to precede
7.3 asserts rq clock under lock: update_rq_clock() before detach/attach and MOTO long-wait timestamp read under the src lock
Refuse to load if the task vendor area is smaller than walt_task_struct (android_arch_task_struct_size missing); BUILD_BUG_ON size > 512
sw_cycle_counter module parameter (default off) selects the shipped software cycle counter; used in QEMU where qcom,gclk MMIO is absent
sched_ext enable-state hook not registered (7.3 lacks it; sched_ext unused on device)
SCHED_PROXY_EXEC (7.3): never migrate mutex-blocked tasks or rq->donor (native can_migrate_task rule); 6.12 had no proxy execution
pending: qcom,gclk MMIO counters, SCMI cpufreq, perf HAL / thermal_pause / moto_sched consumers on hardware
